en: The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard showing a prominent tower structure on a hill overlooking a river with boats and a few buildings nearby. The left side of the card features the tower and some trees, while the right side shows the riverfront and distant scenery. The text on the postcard includes the name 'Nijmegen' and 'Belvédère.' There is additional publishing information at the bottom.
